title: ロボティクス入門
subtitle: Introduction to Robotics
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn essentials of robotics engineering.
(2) Learn the relationships among the fields of the future society and industries.
(3) Set goals for own career design as robotic engineers as students of the department of robotics.
advice:
Consider and explain the future development of robotics field and describe your career plans and future goals.
Students are required to actively participate in classes.
requiredKnowledge: It is important that students not only learn from the textbook and the practice of this course but also understand the role of robotics and identify fields of robotics engineers.

activityGoals.body: Understand the field of robotics and explain clearly own goals to be achieved in department of robotics.
Explain the summary of robot components and design technology.
Explain the summary of measurement, control, information technology.
Explain the summary of system integration technology.
